Applications from international applicants go through uni-assist, and for English-taught master's programmes the summer deadline is 30 November 2026, so there are only days left in this round.

admissions.description:
The Jacobs Graduate School at Technion registers master's and doctoral candidates twice a year. Registration for the Spring semester of 2026-27 is open until 30 November 2026, and the next window, for the Winter semester of 2027-28, runs from 1 March to 30 April 2027. Candidates who studied abroad use the international track, coordinated by the International Students' Coordinator.

Several master's programmes accept students only in the Winter semester, including Management and Behavioural Science, the MBA, Urban and Regional Planning, Economics, Systems Engineering and Urban Engineering. Applicants may apply to only one department, and PhD candidates and some master's candidates must find an advisor before applying.

African applicants should contact the coordinator before applying, check their department's test requirements (for example the GRE in Aerospace and Electrical Engineering) and plan for an Israeli student visa and mandatory health insurance.

admissions.description:
NTNU runs English-taught two-year master's programmes for international applicants in Trondheim, Gjøvik and Ålesund. Applicants from outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland, including Africans, must apply in a short window from 1 November to 1 December 2026; results come around the end of February 2027.

Admission is highly competitive. Applicants need a bachelor's degree with an average grade of at least C on the ECTS scale (NTNU converts foreign grades), a recent English test, and documented funding for living costs. NTNU charges tuition to non-EU students and does not offer scholarships that cover tuition.

Several African countries face extra document rules: applicants with degrees from Ethiopia, Eritrea, Ghana and Nigeria must post hard-copy transcripts, and degrees from DR Congo, Liberia, Libya, Sierra Leone and Somalia need recognition from Norway's HK-dir.

English test (IELTS, TOEFL or Pearson) no older than two years at the deadline
Programme-specific requirements
Documentation of funding for non-EU applicants

Kyushu University offers four-year undergraduate programmes taught in English, apart from Japanese language classes, for students entering in October 2027. The options are in the School of Interdisciplinary Science and Innovation and in engineering and agriculture, covering Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, Applied Chemistry, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, and Bioresource and Bioenvironment.

admissions.deadline_note: Applicants from outside the EU/EEA must submit between 16 November and 14 December 2026 for the summer semester 2027. Applications sent outside this window are cancelled and the applicant is blocked from applying again for two semesters.

admissions.application_fee: EUR 50 per degree programme (admission procedure fee).
admissions.description:
The University of Graz, Austria's second-oldest university, accepts applications from people with foreign school or university qualifications twice a year. For the summer semester 2027, which begins on 1 March 2027, applicants from outside the European Union and European Economic Area have a short window from 16 November to 14 December 2026 to apply for bachelor's, diploma and master's programmes.

Most bachelor's programmes are taught in German and need German at C1 level, while a group of master's programmes run with Graz University of Technology under the NAWI Graz partnership are taught in English, including Advanced Materials Science, Biotechnology, Chemical and Pharmaceutical Engineering, Chemistry, Technical Chemistry and Data Science. Applicants without enough German can be admitted to a university preparation programme first (A2 German is the minimum to start it).

Applications are made online through UNIGRAZonline and checked by the Student Office, which can accept the applicant, ask for missing documents within a set time, offer a place in the preparation programme, or refuse admission. Because the review can take weeks to months and non-EU students also need a residence permit, applicants should submit as early in the window as possible.
degree_names: MSc Advanced Materials Science (NAWI Graz, English)
MSc Chemical and Pharmaceutical Engineering (NAWI Graz, English)
MSc Computational Social Systems (via TU Graz)
Arqus Joint Master's in European Studies
requirements: Bachelor's/diploma: a general higher-education entrance qualification (school-leaving certificate, or a completed three-year degree)
Some countries also require passing the national university entrance exam
Master's: a relevant undergraduate degree of at least three years
German at C1 for German-taught bachelor's programmes (A2 minimum to enter the preparation programme)
Proof of English for English-taught master's (see the language-certificate page)
Original foreign documents must be legalised

origin_notes.note: Non-EU/EEA applicants must apply in the earlier non-EU window and will need an Austrian residence permit for study.

admissions.how_to_apply: Register and apply in UNIGRAZonline (online.uni-graz.at) within the 16 November to 14 December 2026 window, upload your documents and pay the EUR 50 fee for each programme. Watch for requests for missing documents, and use the Welcome Center's help with visas and residence permits once admitted.

School-leaving certificate or degree certificate with transcript or Diploma Supplement (ECTS)
Sworn translations of documents not in German or English
Extra supplement form for NAWI Graz programmes
admissions.selection_process: The Student Office checks each application. Possible outcomes are admission, a request for missing documents with a deadline, admission to the university preparation programme (VGUH) to improve German, or rejection. Biology, Pharmacy, Psychology and Law have separate admission procedures (registration for 2027/28 runs 1 March to 4 May 2027).
important_dates: Non-EU application window, summer semester 2027: 16 November to 14 December 2026
EU/EEA master's window: 7 January to 15 March 2027
Admission procedure registration (Biology, Pharmacy, Psychology, Law) for 2027/28: 1 March to 4 May 2027
admissions.about_provider: The University of Graz (Universität Graz), founded in 1585, is a large public comprehensive university in Graz, Austria. It runs English-taught science master's programmes jointly with Graz University of Technology through NAWI Graz and offers a Welcome Center for international students.

admissions.description:
MBZUAI in Abu Dhabi accepts applications for Fall 2027 graduate study until 15 December 2026 at 5pm Gulf Standard Time. Alongside its funded research MSc and PhD programmes, the university offers the Master in Applied Artificial Intelligence (MAAI), a fee-paying, 34-credit programme that receives no university or faculty funding.

Applicants need a STEM bachelor's degree such as computer science, electrical or computer engineering, mathematics or physics, and take an online screening exam in mathematics and programming. A subset of applicants is invited to a technical interview, and decisions are released by 31 March 2027, with offers to be accepted by 15 April 2027.

The programme suits African engineers and computer scientists who can fund their studies and want a practical AI master's at a specialised AI university. Applicants who also want a funded place should check the separate funded MSc route.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in a STEM field (computer science, electrical or computer engineering, mathematics, physics or similar) from a recognised institution
Minimum CGPA of 3.0 or 3.5 out of 4.0, depending on the programme
Proof of English proficiency
Online screening exam in mathematics and programming
Technical interview if invited
Final-year students may apply with a transcript
admissions.financial_aid: The MAAI is self-funded and receives no university or faculty funding.

origin_notes.note: Degrees obtained outside the UAE need a UAE Ministry of Education Certificate of Recognition during the first semester.

admissions.how_to_apply: Apply through the MBZUAI online application portal before 15 December 2026, upload your documents and pay the AED 200 fee, then complete the screening exam. Only one application is allowed per cycle.
documents: Bachelor's transcript and degree certificate (or expected graduation letter)
admissions.selection_process: Applicants take an online screening exam (mathematics and programming); a subset is invited to a technical interview. Decisions are released by 31 March 2027.
admissions.about_provider: MBZUAI is a graduate research university in Abu Dhabi dedicated entirely to artificial intelligence. It offers master's and doctoral programmes in machine learning, computer vision, natural language processing and related fields.
admissions.notes: Degrees from outside the UAE need a Certificate of Recognition from the UAE Ministry of Education, to be provided in the first semester.

admissions.title: First-Year Admission for International Applicants, Regular Decision (Fall 2027)
admissions.deadline_note: Regular Decision deadline is 1 January; the page prints no year but describes entry in Fall 2027. Early Action (1 November) has passed.
admissions.description:
Georgetown University in Washington, DC admits international first-year students to its undergraduate schools through the same process as US applicants; the admissions office states that citizenship does not affect how an application is reviewed. This entry covers the Regular Decision round for students entering in Fall 2027.

Regular Decision applications are due on 1 January, with decisions by 1 April and a reply date of 1 May. Georgetown accepts either its own application or the Common Application, and it requires SAT or ACT scores unless an applicant cannot reach a test centre.

The written supplement is substantial (two short essays, a personal essay and a school-specific essay), so applicants from African schools should start early and make sure their school can send four years of records.
requirements: Four years of secondary school records (for Fall 2027 entry, from the 2023-2024 academic year onwards)
SAT or ACT scores (exception only if no test centre is accessible); AP scores recommended
English test (Duolingo, IELTS or TOEFL) recommended if your school does not teach in English; no minimum scores stated
A-level, IB or French Baccalaureate results sent by the school
admissions.financial_aid: Georgetown offers a very limited number of need-based scholarships to international students. Applicants must say on the application that they will apply for aid and submit the CSS Profile; the financial aid application is due 1 February.
admissions.how_to_apply: Submit the Georgetown Application or the Common Application by 1 January, have your school send the school report and recommendations, and send SAT or ACT scores (College Board code 5244, ACT code 0668). Track missing documents in the applicant portal.
documents: School report with transcript, school profile and counselor letter
Counselor recommendation and one teacher recommendation (a second is optional)
Writing supplement: two 250-word essays, a 650-word personal essay and a 500-word school-specific essay
Certified English translations of non-English transcripts
CSS Profile if applying for aid
admissions.selection_process: Applications are read in the context of each applicant's school and curriculum. An alumni interview is offered where possible, although some international applicants may not be assigned one.
admissions.about_provider: Georgetown University is a private research university in Washington, DC, founded in 1789. It has six undergraduate schools, including the Walsh School of Foreign Service.
admissions.notes: Admitted students request their I-20 or DS-2019 through the Office of Global Services (newinternational@georgetown.edu).

admissions.title: MSc Interdisciplinary Brain Sciences (Autumn 2027)
admissions.deadline_note: The page sets the deadline as 1 January of the starting year, which is 1 January 2027 for the September 2027 start.
admissions.description:
The MSc in Interdisciplinary Brain Sciences (IDB) is an English-taught neuroscience master's run by the Neuroscience Center Zurich at the University of Zurich. It admits students once a year for a September start, and applications for autumn 2027 must be in by 1 January 2027.

Applicants need a bachelor's degree in a related field from a Swiss university or a foreign university ranked within the world's top 1,500. Students choose preferred mentors as part of the application, and shortlisted candidates have an online interview.

No TOEFL, IELTS or GRE is required, but non-Swiss applicants must show they can finance their studies, as the programme offers no fellowships to students without a Swiss bachelor's.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline from a Swiss university or a foreign university ranked in the world's top 1,500
Universities ranked 1,000 to 1,500 or universities of applied sciences: average of at least 5.0 on the Swiss scale
Medicine, nursing, veterinary and physiotherapy backgrounds are not eligible
Missing course areas may require extra ECTS
No English test or GRE required

origin_notes.note: Non-Swiss applicants must provide a financial statement, and Swiss migration authorities require proof of funds for the visa.

admissions.how_to_apply: Submit the programme's online application form with all documents by 1 January 2027 and save the confirmation screen, as no email is sent. If selected, complete the formal UZH admission application by 30 April 2027.
documents: Full transcript with course descriptions, learning outcomes and ECTS
Optional referee letter and referee contact details
admissions.selection_process: An admission committee reviews files and interviews shortlisted applicants online, with a shortlist by April. Selected candidates then apply formally to UZH by 30 April.
important_dates: Formal UZH application for selected candidates: 30 April 2027
admissions.about_provider: The University of Zurich is Switzerland's largest university. The Neuroscience Center Zurich is a joint centre of UZH and ETH Zurich and one of Europe's largest neuroscience networks.
admissions.notes: Start the Swiss student visa process in parallel; the committee's letter can support it.

admissions.description:
The University of Edinburgh has been taking undergraduate applications for entry in 2027 since 1 September 2026. All first-degree applications go through UCAS, the UK's central admissions service, and the same timetable applies to home and international applicants: there is no separate, later round for overseas students.

For most programmes the date that matters is 13 January 2027, the UCAS equal consideration deadline. Applications that arrive by then are guaranteed to be considered on the same footing, and they receive a decision no later than the UCAS reject-by-default date in May 2027. Some degrees remain open after January and UCAS lists which ones; later applications are judged one by one, depending on places left.

Several subjects have extra steps. Medicine and veterinary medicine had an earlier deadline of 15 October 2026, art and design programmes require a portfolio, and the BA Childhood Practice has its own closing date of 31 March. African applicants should therefore check the page of their chosen degree as well as the general timetable.

admissions.selection_process: Applications received by the UCAS deadline are considered equally and get a decision by the UCAS reject-by-default date in May 2027. Applications sent after the deadline, where a degree is still open, are assessed individually.

Taipei Medical University is accepting international applications for its master's and doctoral programmes starting in September 2027 through its General Track. The online system opened on 2 November 2026 and closes on 27 January 2027, with interviews in early April and results on 7 May 2027.

Applicants need proof of English at CEFR B1 for master's (B2 for PhD), unless they hold a passport from an English-speaking country or an English-taught degree, and a bank statement showing at least USD 4,000. One application fee covers up to two programmes.

Admitted students are automatically considered for TMU's merit scholarships, which in the latest published table pay a monthly stipend plus a tuition waiver. TMU also runs an MOE/TMU Elite Scholarship track for African university lecturers and researchers, making it a useful option for African health and biomedical graduates.

requirements: Master's: a bachelor's degree or final-year undergraduate status
English at CEFR B1 for master's (B2 for PhD) via TOEFL (code 3225), IELTS, Duolingo or PTE; waived for passport holders of English-speaking countries or English-taught degrees
GRE optional (code 8834)
Financial statement of at least USD 4,000 dated within the last 3 months
admissions.financial_aid: Admitted students are considered for TMU merit scholarships (latest published table: master's NT$12,000 per month plus full tuition waiver; doctoral NT$16,000 per month plus full tuition waiver, up to 23 months). An MOE/TMU Elite Scholarship (NT$25,000 per month) is available for African university lecturers and researchers, with a spring call expected in January-February 2027.

admissions.about_provider: HKUST is a research university in Clear Water Bay, Hong Kong, founded in 1991 and known for science, engineering and business.

admissions.title: Weizmann School of Science MSc programmes 2027

Applications for the 2027 intake open in November 2026 and close between February and April 2027 depending on the programme.

The school accepts graduates of foreign universities and does not charge an application fee. Standardised tests such as the GRE, TOEFL or IELTS are usually not required for applicants from non-Israeli universities, although non-native English speakers may be asked for an English test.

Admission is selective: a high bachelor's average is expected, and files are judged together with reference letters, which applicants must make sure their referees submit online.
degree_names: MSc Molecular and Cellular Neuroscience track
requirements: BSc from an accredited institution, or in the final year (proof due by the end of the first semester)

TOEFL or IELTS for non-native English speakers when required; GRE usually not required for non-Israeli universities

documents: BSc certificate or confirmation of degree eligibility, if available
Motivation statement (Molecular and Cellular Neuroscience track)
Reference letters submitted online by referees (1-3 advised for Life Sciences)
Certified notarised translations of documents not in English or Hebrew
admissions.selection_process: Admission committees review the complete file and references and may invite candidates to an interview. Incomplete files are not reviewed.
important_dates: Applications open: November 2026 (date to be announced)
Physics, Chemistry, Maths and CS deadline: 31 March 2027
admissions.about_provider: The Weizmann Institute of Science in Rehovot, Israel, is a leading multidisciplinary research institute in the natural and exact sciences. Its graduate school offers MSc and PhD study embedded in research labs.
admissions.notes: Official documents must be on institutional letterhead with stamp and signature.

admissions.title: Graduate Programmes for International Applicants (Fall 2027)

Each programme sets its own closing date, mostly between mid-February and early March 2027, and supporting documents must arrive within two weeks of the application deadline. International applicants also submit financial documents so the university can issue an I-20.

As a California State University campus, Sacramento State offers lower costs than many private US universities, which makes it a practical option for self-funded African students.
requirements: Bachelor's degree with a GPA of about 2.5 to 3.25 depending on the programme
English: TOEFL iBT 4.0 (tests after 21 January 2026), IELTS 6.5, PTE Academic 65 or Duolingo 115
GRE/GMAT depending on the programme
Credential evaluation (WES, ECE or ACEI) for three-year foreign degrees and for the MS Computer Science
admissions.how_to_apply: Apply through Cal State Apply (www2.calstate.edu/apply), pay the USD 70 fee by card or PayPal, and upload transcripts, test scores, passport and financial documents. Send any required credential evaluation and remaining documents within two weeks of your programme's deadline.
documents: Transcripts from all undergraduate and graduate study
important_dates: MS Computer Science: priority 1 February 2027, final 1 March 2027
MA Communication Studies: priority 15 January 2027, final 1 March 2027
admissions.about_provider: California State University, Sacramento (Sacramento State) is a public university in Sacramento, California, and part of the 23-campus California State University system. It offers bachelor's, master's and doctoral programmes.

admissions.title: Queen's University first-year undergraduate admission (Fall 2027)

admissions.description:
Queen's University in Kingston, Ontario, opened applications for its September 2027 first-year programmes on 1 October 2026. International students apply through the Ontario Universities' Application Centre (OUAC), the same system used by Ontario students.

Most programmes accept applications until 1 March 2027, while Commerce, Health Sciences and Nursing close earlier, on 1 February 2027, and need a mandatory supplementary application by 15 February. Every transcript and English test result must reach Queen's by 31 March 2027. Applying by 20 November 2026 gave access to the Major Admission Award, so later applicants should check which awards remain open.

Applicants whose first language is not English must meet Queen's English proficiency scores or qualify for a waiver, and students who fall slightly short can enter through the QBridge English pathway programmes.
requirements: Secondary school completion meeting the programme's competitive average and prerequisites
IELTS Academic 6.5 (no band below 6.0), or TOEFL iBT 4.5 on the new scale (no skill below 4.0) or 88 with 20 per section on older tests
Alternatively CAEL 70, Duolingo 120, PTE Academic 60, Cambridge 175 or LanguageCert 70
English waiver possible for the IB Diploma or three years of full-time English-medium schooling
Supplementary application for Commerce, Health Sciences and Nursing
admissions.financial_aid: Queen's has admission awards and bursaries; the Major Admission Award required an application by 20 November 2026. Amounts for international students are not stated on the dates page.
admissions.how_to_apply: Apply through OUAC, then use the Queen's SOLUS student account to follow your file and awards. Ask your testing body to send English scores directly and send English waiver requests to admission@queensu.ca.
documents: English test scores sent directly by the testing body (TOEFL code 0949)
important_dates: Commerce, Health Sciences, Nursing deadline: 1 February 2027
All documents and English scores: 31 March 2027
admissions.about_provider: Queen's University is a public research university in Kingston, Ontario, and one of Canada's oldest degree-granting institutions. It runs the QBridge pathway programmes for students who need extra English preparation.
admissions.notes: English scores are valid for two years. QBridge Accelerated (8-week summer course) needs IELTS 6.0 and QBridge EAP needs IELTS 5.5.

admissions.title: Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute Graduate Admission, Master's (Fall 2027)
admissions.deadline_note: Fall 2027 master's deadline 1 March 2027 (doctoral 15 December 2026); engineering master's review starts 5 January and late applications are reviewed after earlier ones.

Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (RPI) in Troy, New York, accepts applications for its Fall 2027 master's programmes until 1 March 2027. Engineering master's applications are reviewed from 5 January, and the Master of Architecture has a 15 January priority date, so applying early helps.

Applicants need a four-year US bachelor's degree or an international equivalent by the time they enrol. The GRE is optional for most programmes but strongly recommended for computer science and cognitive science, and required for the management PhD.

Applicants may apply to only one degree programme per term, so choose carefully.
requirements: Four-year bachelor's degree (or equivalent) completed before enrolment
English: TOEFL iBT 88 (or 4.5), IELTS Academic 6.5, Duolingo 120 or PTE 59, less than two years old (waivers for citizens of English-speaking countries and graduates of English-medium universities)
GRE optional for most programmes; strongly recommended for CS and cognitive science
admissions.how_to_apply: Apply through RPI's graduate application portal, upload the statement, CV and transcripts, and arrange two recommendations. Send TOEFL or GRE scores to institution code 2757.
documents: Portfolio for architecture programmes; other programme-specific items
admissions.selection_process: Programme committees review complete applications; earlier applications receive priority.
admissions.about_provider: Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute is a private technological research university in Troy, New York, founded in 1824 and known for engineering, computing and the sciences.

admissions.title: Bachelor's and Master's Programmes in English (Autumn 2027)
admissions.deadline_note: Applications for all Autumn 2027 bachelor's and most master's programmes run from 1 November 2026 to 1 March 2027; the MA AI for Sustainable Societies runs from 2 December 2026 to 2 February 2027. The page does not give separate dates for non-EU applicants.
admissions.tuition: Bachelor's: EUR 4,600 to 5,800 per year (for example EUR 5,800 for Law, EUR 4,600 for Liberal Arts in Humanities). Master's: mostly EUR 4,000 to 5,200 per year; Digital Learning Games and Human-Computer Interaction cost EUR 7,000 per year for non-EU/EEA students.
admissions.application_fee: EUR 100 per international applicant, paid once for up to two programmes; not refunded if documents are missing or the admission exam is failed.
admissions.description:
Tallinn University is accepting applications for its English-taught bachelor's and master's programmes starting in autumn 2027. The admission round runs from 1 November 2026 to 1 March 2027 for all bachelor's programmes and almost all master's programmes, with a shorter window for the MA in AI for Sustainable Societies.

International applicants pay a one-time application fee, and their applications are only processed once the fee has been received; the university says applicants get feedback within about two weeks of payment. Tuition is charged per year and can be paid under different payment plans, but non-EU students must pay the first semester to finalise their place, which also matters for the Estonian residence permit.

Fees in Tallinn are moderate by European standards, and the university also publishes a page on tuition waivers and scholarships, so the round is worth considering for African students looking for affordable English-taught degrees in the Baltics.
requirements: For bachelor's: secondary school leaving certificate giving access to higher education
For master's: bachelor's degree or equivalent
Proof of English proficiency (see the university's English requirements page)
Payment of the EUR 100 application fee
admissions.financial_aid: The university publishes a Tuition Waivers and Scholarships page for its programmes; the deadlines page itself does not give details.
admissions.how_to_apply: Choose up to two programmes, submit the online application with your documents between 1 November 2026 and 1 March 2027, and pay the EUR 100 application fee; the application is reviewed only after payment. If admitted, non-EU students pay the first semester's tuition to confirm the place.
important_dates: Deadline (MA AI for Sustainable Societies): 2 February 2027
admissions.about_provider: Tallinn University is one of Estonia's largest public universities, based in the capital Tallinn. It focuses on humanities, social sciences, education, digital technologies and the arts, and teaches a range of degree programmes in English.
admissions.notes: Ukrainian citizens are exempt from the application fee for 2027/28. Apply early if you need an Estonian student residence permit, because acceptance is finalised only after the first tuition payment.

admissions.title: University of Alberta undergraduate admission (Fall 2027)
admissions.deadline_note: Most programmes close on 1 March 2027 (11:59 pm Mountain Time); Nursing, Dental Hygiene, Dentistry, Medicine and Law have their own dates.
admissions.duration: Four-year bachelor's degrees in most programmes
admissions.tuition: International students get a tuition guarantee for the whole programme (amount by programme in the university's cost calculator); a CAD 5,000 tuition deposit is needed to accept an offer.
admissions.description:
The University of Alberta opened applications for admission, awards and residence for Fall 2027 on 1 October 2026. Most programmes take applications until 1 March 2027, and offers are made on a rolling basis as files are completed.

International students are admitted on their complete academic record, with five academic subjects required (varying by programme) and proof of English proficiency. The university publishes requirements for many curricula, including WAEC results from West Africa, A Levels, IB and AP, and runs a Year One Foundation Program for students missing required courses.

International undergraduates benefit from a tuition guarantee, so their tuition is fixed for the length of their programme. Accepting an offer requires a CAD 5,000 deposit, which also triggers the Provincial Attestation Letter needed for a Canadian study permit.
requirements: Completion of five academic subjects as required by the programme
Competitive grade average (varies by programme and year)
English proficiency through an approved test, approved courses, English-medium education or the Bridging Program
Spoken English Proficiency for Health Sciences and Education
WAEC and other international curricula accepted per the university's country pages
admissions.financial_aid: International undergraduate scholarships are listed on the university's General International Undergraduate Scholarships page (amounts not stated on the dates page).
admissions.how_to_apply: Apply online with the CAD 150 fee, upload transcripts and English evidence, and follow your file through Launchpad. Students outside Canada can write to welcome@ualberta.ca.
documents: Transcripts (final ones by 15 June 2027 for post-secondary applicants)
Self-reported final high school marks by 30 April 2027
admissions.selection_process: Applications are assessed on the complete academic history, subject requirements, grades and English proficiency, with offers made on a rolling basis.
important_dates: Self-report final high school marks: 30 April 2027
Accept offers made before 1 April: 1 May 2027
admissions.about_provider: The University of Alberta is a large public research university in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. It admits students from many school systems and offers a Bridging Program and a Year One Foundation Program.

admissions.title: NCKU international degree admission for bachelor's, master's and PhD (Fall 2027)

Applicants can choose up to three departments in one application. Programmes are taught in English, in Chinese, or in both; full-English bachelor's options include the International Bachelor Degree Program on Energy and the Department of Public Health, and many master's and PhD programmes such as Geomatics, International Management, and Industrial and Information Management are offered in English.

Departments assess the submitted documents and may add interviews, tests or extra documents. Admission and scholarship results are released together. Applicants from some countries, including Nigeria, must have a guarantor in Taiwan for visa purposes.
degree_names: International Bachelor Degree Program on Energy
Department of Industrial and Information Management

Eligibility as an international (foreign) degree student under NCKU rules
Department-specific requirements

NCCU is strong in social sciences, business, law, communication and languages, and has many English-taught programmes, which makes it a good choice for African students interested in policy, media or business in East Asia.
degree_names: Programmes not offered in Round 1 (see NCCU Round 2 programme list)

Programme-specific academic and language requirements

WU strongly advises non-EU/EEA applicants to use the first priority deadline because of residence permit times; the later deadlines remain open to them.

WU Vienna, one of Europe's largest business universities, admits students to its English-taught master's programmes for autumn 2027 through a rolling process. Applications opened on 1 September 2026 and are assessed in batches after each of three priority deadlines: 8 October 2026, 8 January 2027 and 8 March 2027.

The English-taught master's programmes include Digital Economy, Economics, Marketing, Quantitative Finance, Socio-Ecological Economics and Policy, Supply Chain Management, and International Management/CEMS. Results follow each round: mid-December 2026 for the first, end of March 2027 for the second and mid-June 2027 for the third. Applicants can be admitted to only one English-taught MSc.

For applicants from Africa and other non-EU countries, WU's main advice is to apply early, ideally by the first priority deadline, because a residence permit for Austria takes time. Those who missed it can still use the January or March rounds, but should plan visa steps right after an offer.
requirements: A suitable bachelor's degree for the chosen programme (details on each programme page)

English proof: TOEFL iBT 5 on the new scale (tests from 21 January 2026; 100 on the old scale), IELTS Academic 7.0, Oxford Test of English Advanced 150, CAE/CPE, or a fully English-taught three-year bachelor's or two-year master's
Complete application by the chosen priority deadline

admissions.how_to_apply: Apply through WU's online application tool for master's programmes before the priority deadline you choose, uploading complete documents and your English certificate. If admitted, accept within 10 days and pay the deposit, then start your Austrian residence permit application at once.
documents: Online application in WU's application tool
Degree certificates and transcripts (only complete applications are considered)
admissions.selection_process: Applications are grouped by priority deadline and assessed in batches. important_dates: Priority deadline II: 8 January 2027 (results end of March 2027; last deadline for International Management/CEMS)

admissions.notes: WU strongly recommends that non-EU/EEA applicants apply in the first round; late applicants risk not getting a residence permit in time. Duolingo is not listed among accepted English tests.

degree_names: Bachelor's, master's and doctoral programmes in English and Chinese (see Fall 2027 handbook)
requirements: Eligible as an international student (not overseas Chinese, Hong Kong/Macau or mainland student channels)
English-taught: IELTS or TOEFL; Chinese-taught: TOCFL
Department-specific requirements
Master's and doctoral: faculty supervisor confirmation

Study plan (bachelor's and master's) or research proposal (doctoral)

admissions.title: Graduate programmes, international applicants (Fall 2027)
admissions.deadline_note: International closing date is 12 March 2027 unless a programme states otherwise; many programmes close earlier (e.g. 1 December 2026 preferred deadline for The Creative School and FEAS) and some, such as Computer Science MSc and Civil Engineering MASc, are already closed to international applicants.
admissions.description:
Toronto Metropolitan University (formerly Ryerson) has opened fall 2027 applications for its roughly 70 master's, PhD and professional master's diploma programmes. For international applicants the general closing date is 12 March 2027, but each programme can set its own earlier date, so the programme table on the application dates page is the reference.

Applications completed before the first consideration date of 22 January 2027 get priority for both admission and graduate funding; later applications are reviewed only if places remain. Files are assessed only once every document, including the letters of recommendation, has arrived.

For African graduates, TMU offers practice-oriented programmes in engineering, business, media, urban planning and health in the centre of Toronto. Checking the specific programme deadline early is essential because popular programmes close sooner.
requirements: Completed bachelor's degree meeting the programme's admission requirements
International applicant: holds a study permit or lives outside Canada and is not a citizen or permanent resident
All required documents, including recommendation letters, before review
admissions.how_to_apply: Choose your programme from the fall 2027 table, check its own deadline, and apply online through TMU's graduate application portal, then upload all documents and have referees submit letters.
documents: Documents on TMU's required documents page, including letters of recommendation
admissions.selection_process: Programmes review complete applications; those finished by 22 January 2027 receive priority for admission and funding, and later files are reviewed as space allows. Programmes may close early if demand far exceeds places.
important_dates: Preferred international deadline for The Creative School and FEAS programmes: 1 December 2026
admissions.about_provider: Toronto Metropolitan University is a public university in downtown Toronto, known for career-focused programmes in engineering, business, media, design and community services. It was renamed from Ryerson University in 2022.
admissions.notes: Apply early to be considered for graduate funding.

admissions.title: Agnes Scott College first-year admission for international students (Fall 2027)
admissions.deadline_note: Regular Decision closes 15 March for the Fall 2027 entry; Early Action II closes 16 January. Early Decision (1 November) and Early Action I (15 November) have passed.
admissions.tuition: 2026-27 figures for international students: tuition USD 54,321; housing and dining USD 14,255; fees about USD 900; total USD 69,176 (plus books, personal costs and mandatory health insurance of about USD 2,550).
admissions.application_fee: USD 30, required for international applicants and not waivable
admissions.description:
Agnes Scott College is a women's liberal arts college near Atlanta that welcomes international applicants to its four-year undergraduate degrees for the Fall 2027 entry. Students apply through the Common Application and complete the college's SUMMIT general-education experience alongside their chosen major.

Two rounds are still open: Early Action II, due 16 January 2027, and Regular Decision, due 15 March 2027, with decisions sent on a rolling basis and a non-refundable USD 500 deposit due by 1 May. SAT and ACT scores are optional, but non-native speakers need an English test unless they come from a listed English-speaking country.

The college gives no need-based aid to international students, so the main support is merit scholarships: every Fall 2027 admit is considered for the Agnes Scott USD 100K+ Promise, and families must show they can cover the remaining cost before an I-20 is issued.
requirements: Secondary school completion with an official transcript in English (sealed or attested)
SAT/ACT optional
English proficiency unless exempt: TOEFL iBT 80, IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 110, Cambridge C1 Advanced 176, ELS level 12, or SAT EBRW 520 / ACT English 20
Applicants from listed English-speaking countries (including South Africa) are exempt from the English test
Proof of funding for the I-20 (bank statement or scholarship letter less than six months old)
admissions.financial_aid: No need-based aid for international students and CSS Profile is not used. Merit awards: the Agnes Scott USD 100K+ Promise (at least USD 25,000 a year, USD 100,000-136,000 over four years, based on weighted GPA); most other merit awards are USD 23,000-26,000; on-campus work-study about USD 2,300 a year.
admissions.how_to_apply: Submit the Common Application with the USD 30 fee, then upload the remaining documents through the Agnes Scott admission portal. Send English test scores directly (TOEFL code 5002) and the financial certification so the college can issue an I-20 after admission.
documents: Secondary school report and international school supplement
Official high school transcript in English (notarised translation if needed)
English test score (TOEFL code 5002; MyBest accepted)
Passport bio page or national ID
admissions.selection_process: Applications are reviewed holistically, looking at courses taken, grades, the essay, activities, recommendations and any test scores sent. An interview or InitialView recording is optional.
admissions.about_provider: Agnes Scott College is a private liberal arts college for women in Decatur, Georgia, in the Atlanta area. Its SUMMIT curriculum combines leadership development and global learning with every degree.
admissions.notes: The college gives one full tuition, room and board Marvin B. Perry Presidential Scholarship each year. Its pages give two different scholarship priority dates (15 January and the Early Action II deadline), so apply by 15 January to be safe.

admissions.title: Boston University College of Engineering MS, MEng and LEAP (Fall 2027)

The college advises international students to check visa appointment waiting times in their home country early, since appointments can take two to three months.

Admission works in rounds: applicants submit their application before one of the round dates, sit the university's admission exam a few days later and receive a decision about a month after that.

The first round closes on 9 December, with the admission exam on 12 December and decisions on 21 January; this is also the only round for international applicants to Medicine. A second round closes on 9 March (exam 13 March, decisions 15 April), followed by a 15 April round and rolling rounds from 31 May through August for degrees that still have places.

International students studying outside Spain are not asked for a minimum grade average, except for Medicine, where international applicants need a grade of 7 or higher. Because places fill over time, applying in the December or March round gives the widest choice of degrees.

documents: Online application through the miUNAV portal (document list not stated on the deadlines page)
admissions.selection_process: Each round has a set application deadline, an admission exam and a resolution date (for example: application by 9 December, exam 12 December, decision 21 January, enrolment by 23 February). Later rounds only offer degrees that still have places.
important_dates: Round 1 (all degrees; Medicine for international students): apply by 9 December, exam 12 December, decision 21 January, enrol by 23 February
Round 2: apply by 9 March, exam 13 March, decision 15 April, enrol by 31 May
Rolling rounds (degrees with places): from 31 May through August, exams on Thursdays
admissions.about_provider: The University of Navarra (Universidad de Navarra) is a private Catholic university founded in 1952, with its main campus in Pamplona and further sites in San Sebastián, Madrid and Barcelona. It is known for medicine, communication, law, business and architecture.

Master's entry criteria are set per programme. RSU emails successful applicants an offer of a study place, and tuition must then be paid within two weeks, after which it is paid per semester.

For most African applicants, who need a Latvian visa, the window runs from 1 March to 1 May 2027. If your country is on Latvia's list of 'Additional Assessment Countries', the window closes earlier, on 1 April 2027, so check the list linked from the RSU page before planning your application.

Admission involves an academic recognition check of the applicant's diploma (within about 20 working days), a motivational interview and, for some applicants, a mathematics test, followed by a faculty decision within about five working days. Applicants upload a motivation letter, an English CV and their certificates to the university's DreamApply portal.

The university notes that the residence permit procedure through VFS Global can take two to three months and that dormitory places are limited, so African applicants should apply well before the deadline.

Motivational interview

Master's applicants: official transcript sent by email directly from the issuing institution

documents: Diploma and diploma supplement or transcript
Passport valid for at least two more years
Copy of residence permit or visa, if held
admissions.selection_process: Applications go through academic recognition of the diploma, a motivational interview and, where required, a mathematics test, and the faculty then decides on admission.

admissions.about_provider: Vytautas Magnus University (VMU) is a public university in Kaunas, Lithuania, known for its liberal arts (artes liberales) model of study. It offers bachelor's, master's and integrated programmes, many of them taught in English.

Debrecen is popular with African students, especially in medicine, engineering and agriculture. Students who want a Stipendium Hungaricum scholarship must apply separately through the Tempus portal rather than this self-financed route.

admissions.title: Master's programmes for international applicants (Winter Semester 2027/28)

admissions.application_fee: uni-assist processing fee (amount not stated on the page)
admissions.description:
Paderborn University's master's programmes, both German- and English-taught, accept international applicants for the winter semester 2027/28, which begins in October 2027. Applications through uni-assist are due by 31 May 2027.

Applicants who are going through the university entrance examination route also have a 31 May deadline for the winter semester, and those applications then continue through Paderborn's own portal. Applicants with a recognised language certificate can apply to the university directly.

The winter intake gives African graduates the most time to prepare transcripts, translations and language tests, and it is the main intake for most German master's programmes.
degree_names: German- and English-taught master's programmes at Paderborn University
requirements: Bachelor's degree relevant to the chosen programme
Proof of German or English depending on the teaching language
Application via uni-assist (or directly with a recognised language certificate)

documents: Other documents as required by uni-assist and the programme
admissions.selection_process: uni-assist checks foreign qualifications and forwards eligible applications to the university, which decides on admission.
admissions.about_provider: Paderborn University is a public university in North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. Its international office handles applications from degree-seeking students with foreign qualifications.

admissions.title: Shanghai Jiao Tong University international graduate admission, self-funded master's and PhD (September 2027)
admissions.deadline_note: 31 May 2027 (Beijing time) is the deadline for self-funded applicants; scholarship applicants face earlier deadlines.
admissions.tuition: Per programme, listed in the SJTU 2027 International Graduate Program Catalog
admissions.description:
Shanghai Jiao Tong University's 2027 International Graduate Admissions Guide covers master's and doctoral study starting in September 2027, in English-taught and Chinese-taught programmes. Applications opened on 5 November 2026, and self-funded applicants can apply until 31 May 2027.

Applicants who also want a scholarship must meet earlier dates: 15 December 2026 (first round) and 15 February 2027 (final) for the Chinese Government Scholarship through the university, and 31 March 2027 for Shanghai Government and SJTU scholarships. Master's programmes usually take two to three years, and the full programme list with tuition is in the university's 2027 catalogue.

Applications are made entirely online with colour scans of original documents, and some schools require a supervisor's letter of intent.
requirements: Non-Chinese citizen with a foreign ordinary passport
Master's: a degree equivalent to a Chinese bachelor's (final-year students may apply with an expected-graduation certificate)
Meet the SJTU language requirements for the chosen programme
Good health and no criminal record
Scholarship applicants: aged 35 or under for master's
admissions.financial_aid: Chinese Government Scholarship (Type B agency number 10248), Shanghai Government Scholarship, SJTU Scholarship, SJTU Tuition Waiver Scholarship and school scholarships, each with its own deadline.
admissions.how_to_apply: Apply on apply.sjtu.edu.cn, upload colour scans of original documents (no phone photos or photocopies), and pay the RMB 800 fee after uploads are complete. Contact gs.admission@sjtu.edu.cn with questions.
documents: Degree verification report (CSCSE or CHSI), in principle
Full undergraduate transcripts (plus GPA statement if not shown)
Passport valid at least 12 months beyond enrolment
Photo (JPG under 200 KB, at least 295 x 413 px)
Two recommendation letters from associate professors or equivalent
Letter of intent for supervision (certain schools)
important_dates: CGS through the university: 15 December 2026 (first round), 15 February 2027 (final)
Shanghai Government and SJTU scholarships: 31 March 2027
admissions.about_provider: Shanghai Jiao Tong University is a national key university under China's Ministry of Education and the Shanghai government, with over 130 years of history. It is one of China's leading research universities, strong in engineering, medicine, science and management.
admissions.notes: Documents must be in Chinese or English, or notarised translations. Apply for scholarships either through the university or through a Chinese embassy, not both.

admissions.title: Master's Programmes 2027-28 (Ordinary Admission Periods)
admissions.deadline_note: Three ordinary periods: 1 Dec 2026 to 31 Jan 2027, 1 Feb to 31 Mar 2027 and 1 Apr to 31 May 2027. Programmes may close early once places are filled, so applying in the first period is safest.

admissions.application_fee: Not stated on the pages read
admissions.description:
Universidad Carlos III de Madrid opens admission to its 2027-28 master's programmes on 1 December 2026. Ordinary admission runs in three periods, each with its own results date, and a programme can close before the last period if its places fill up.

UC3M teaches several master's fully in English, including aeronautical engineering, telecommunication engineering, space engineering, economics, finance and international legal practice, and others bilingually in Spanish and English, such as cybersecurity. Bilingual programmes require a minimum level of Spanish.

Some programmes have their own calendars: master's degrees for regulated professions at the Escuela Politécnica Superior and the law practice master's (Abogacía) have different cut-off dates. Five per cent of places are reserved for applicants with a recognised disability of at least 33 per cent.
requirements: Bachelor's degree giving access to master's studies
English or Spanish level as set by each programme (see UC3M language requirements)
Minimum Spanish level for bilingual programmes
admissions.how_to_apply: Register for an access key on the UC3M postgraduate portal, then submit your application for up to the programmes allowed and upload the required documents. Results are sent by email and shown on your application status page.
documents: Online application via the UC3M postgraduate portal
Documents required by the chosen programme
important_dates: Period 1: 1 December 2026 to 31 January 2027 (results from 26 February 2027)
Period 2: 1 February to 31 March 2027 (results from 30 April 2027)
Period 3: 1 April to 31 May 2027 (results from 25 June 2027)
Law practice master (September edition): up to 31 January 2027
admissions.about_provider: Universidad Carlos III de Madrid is a public university in the Madrid region, known for economics, law, engineering and social sciences, with a large number of programmes taught in English.
admissions.notes: Tuition, fees and scholarships are on separate UC3M pages not read here; check the "Ayudas y becas" page for grants.

admissions.title: BA Global Communication and Management (English-taught), Fall 2027
admissions.deadline_note: Early Action runs to 28 February 2027 (Beijing time); final deadline 31 May 2027. Applying early is recommended.
admissions.tuition: RMB 65,000 per year (plus RMB 800 per year medical insurance)
admissions.description:
Zhejiang University's International Business School (ZIBS) admits international students to its four-year, English-taught BA in Global Communication and Management, starting in September 2027 on the Haining international campus. No Chinese is required.

Admission is competitive and based on academic performance, English level and an online interview. Pre-admission notices go out in batches, and tuition must be paid within the time stated on the notice to keep the place.

Applicants from any country with an ordinary non-Chinese passport may apply, including African students. Applicants also need a CSCA mathematics report, a newer requirement for international undergraduates in China.
requirements: Non-Chinese citizen with an ordinary passport
Aged 18 to 25 in principle
High school graduate (pre-graduation certificate accepted at application)
TOEFL 80 or IELTS Academic 6.5 (native speakers exempt)
Valid CSCA Mathematics report taken in English
admissions.financial_aid: ZIBS scholarships of RMB 5,000 to 30,000, paid after arrival; apply through the application system with the scholarship form attached.

origin_notes.note: Former Chinese citizens and some dual nationals must meet extra Ministry of Education residence rules.

admissions.how_to_apply: Apply online through the Zhejiang University international student portal (intlstudent.zju.edu.cn), upload all documents and pay the RMB 800 fee before the deadline. Paper or emailed documents are not reviewed.
documents: High school diploma or pre-graduation certificate
SAT, IB, A-level, ACT or similar results if available
Two recommendation letters (preferably from high school teachers)
admissions.selection_process: Online review of materials, then an online interview for shortlisted applicants. Selection weighs academic performance, English level and interview.
admissions.about_provider: Zhejiang University is one of China's leading research universities, based in Hangzhou. ZIBS is its international business school, teaching in English on the Haining campus with a strong focus on global business.
admissions.notes: The application fee must be paid before the deadline or the application is void. Supplementary materials are generally not accepted after submission.

admissions.title: International Bachelor's Admission (Fall 2027)
admissions.deadline_note: Priority application date 1 March 2027; final deadline 1 June 2027 (dates marked tentative on the page).
admissions.description:
California State University, Monterey Bay (CSUMB), a public campus of the California State University system on the Monterey Bay coast, accepts international students into its bachelor's programmes for Fall 2027. Applications opened on 1 October 2026.

CSUMB runs a single admission cycle rather than early and regular rounds: applications submitted by the 1 March 2027 priority date get first consideration, and the final deadline is 1 June 2027. Supporting documents and the first payment are due by 1 July 2027, and classes begin on 23 August 2027.

The university offers 26 undergraduate majors, and applicants who do not yet meet its English requirement may be considered for conditional admission, which helps African applicants who still need to finish an English test.
requirements: Completed secondary education meeting CSUMB's admission requirements
English proficiency, or conditional admission for students who do not yet meet it
admissions.how_to_apply: Follow the steps on CSUMB's international how-to-apply page, submit the application before the 1 March priority date if possible, and send all documents by 1 July 2027. Questions go to international@csumb.edu.
admissions.about_provider: California State University, Monterey Bay is a public university in Seaside, California, and one of the 23 campuses of the California State University system. It offers 26 bachelor's majors along with graduate programmes.
admissions.notes: The page marks all Fall 2027 dates as tentative and subject to change. Tuition, fees and test requirements are on separate CSUMB pages.

admissions.title: SUNY Buffalo State University international admission (Fall 2027)
admissions.deadline_note: Fall 2027 application and required materials deadline for international students: 1 June 2027 (tuition deposit 1 May 2027). Spring 2028 applications close 1 December 2027.
admissions.duration: Four-year bachelor's degrees; graduate programmes vary
admissions.tuition: 2026-27 estimate for international undergraduates: tuition and fees USD 20,273; living costs USD 17,256; mandatory health insurance USD 2,371; total about USD 39,900. Graduate: tuition and fees USD 18,506, total about USD 37,000.
admissions.description:
SUNY Buffalo State University admits international first-year, transfer and graduate students, with first-year and transfer applications handled together with its International Student and Scholar Services office. The Fall 2027 application and all required materials are due by 1 June 2027, with a tuition deposit due by 1 May 2027 and classes starting on 30 August 2027.

Applicants use the SUNY Application or the Common Application and pay a USD 50 fee. Besides the academic file, international students submit a personal essay and a financial statement, because the I-20 for the student visa is issued only once enough funding for the first year is shown.

At about USD 39,900 a year including living costs, Buffalo State is one of the lower-cost public options in New York State, and first-year students are considered for merit scholarships of USD 1,000 to 4,000 a year.
requirements: Secondary school completion (or prior degree for graduate study)
English test (TOEFL, IELTS, iTEP, PTE Academic or Duolingo) unless English is the official language of the home country and the language of instruction
Proof of funds for the first calendar year (plus USD 5,000 per dependent)
Freshmen and sophomores live on campus until 60 credit hours
NACES course-by-course evaluation for transfer students with foreign transcripts
admissions.financial_aid: First-year merit scholarships based on high school grades and activities: President's Scholars USD 4,000 a year, Provost's USD 3,000, Dean's USD 2,000 and Orange & Black USD 1,000, renewable for up to four years. International scholarships through ISSS require full-time enrolment.
admissions.how_to_apply: Apply through the SUNY Application or Common Application with the USD 50 fee, then send the essay, financial statement, transcripts and English score. Missing documents can be sent to intladmissions@buffalostate.edu.
documents: Financial statement (FSA-4) and proof of funds
Official transcripts sent by email from the school or by mail
important_dates: Fall 2027 application and materials deadline: 1 June 2027
admissions.about_provider: SUNY Buffalo State University is a public university in Buffalo, New York, and part of the State University of New York system.

admissions.title: Simon Fraser University Graduate Programmes (Fall 2027)
admissions.deadline_note: Most Fall 2027 application windows opened 1 October 2026. Closing dates vary by programme: for example Archaeology and Communication (MA thesis) close 15 January 2027, Chemistry closes 1 June 2027. SFU uses the same deadlines for Canadian and international applicants.
admissions.description:
Simon Fraser University's Faculty of Graduate Studies opened most applications for Fall 2027 graduate study on 1 October 2026. Programmes range from archaeology, communication and economics to chemistry, physics, computing science, engineering, education and health sciences.

Each programme has its own application window. Many humanities and social science programmes close in mid-January 2027, while some science programmes accept applications into the spring, such as Chemistry until 1 June 2027. SFU does not set separate international deadlines, but international applicants should leave time for study permits.

SFU says all its PhD programmes and some master's programmes come with guaranteed minimum funding, and Canadian and international students pay the same tuition in most research-based programmes, which is uncommon in Canada and valuable for African applicants.
requirements: Bachelor's degree meeting SFU graduate admission standards
English test for applicants from non-English-majority countries where the programme requires it
Economics: GRE for applicants educated outside Canada
Health Sciences (MPH): WES Canada or ICES credential evaluation if educated outside Canada or the US
admissions.financial_aid: SFU guarantees minimum funding for all PhD programmes and selected master's programmes, and charges Canadian and international students the same tuition in most research-based programmes.
admissions.how_to_apply: Find your programme's window on SFU's applicant questions page, then complete SFU's online graduate application (GoGrad) before your programme's closing date. Contact potential supervisors early for thesis-based programmes.
important_dates: Applications opened for most programmes: 1 October 2026
admissions.about_provider: Simon Fraser University is a public research university with three campuses in the greater Vancouver area (Burnaby, Vancouver and Surrey), British Columbia, Canada.
admissions.notes: Funding: all PhD programmes and some master's programmes have guaranteed minimum funding. Some windows on the page may not yet be updated for 2027, so confirm on your programme page.

admissions.title: Northeastern Khoury College master's programmes in Computer Science, AI, Cybersecurity and Data Science (Fall 2027)
admissions.deadline_note: Fall 2027 deadline for international applicants outside the country applying to US and Canadian campuses; 1 July for international applicants already in the country. Deadline subject to change.
admissions.description:
Khoury College of Computer Sciences at Northeastern University admits students for Fall 2027 to its master's programmes in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Cybersecurity and Data Science, plus interdisciplinary MS options such as Game Science and Design, Health Informatics, Robotics, Internet of Things and Statistics. Students list first, second and third campus preferences across Northeastern's network.

International applicants outside the country have until 15 June 2027. Review is rolling, so earlier applicants hear sooner. Each programme has prerequisites: for example, the MS in Computer Science expects programming, data structures, calculus and discrete maths, and the MS in AI expects programming plus linear algebra or statistics.

African applicants should note that Duolingo is not accepted and that English waivers apply only to a four-year (or doctoral) degree taught in English.
degree_names: MS in Game Science and Design
requirements: Bachelor's degree with minimum GPA 3.0/4.0 (or 8.0/10 or 80/100)
Programme prerequisites (e.g. programming, data structures, calculus, discrete maths for MS CS)
Recommended English: TOEFL 90 or IELTS 6.5 (Duolingo not accepted)
GRE optional; WES evaluation not required
admissions.how_to_apply: Apply at enroll.northeastern.edu/apply, choose up to three campus preferences, and upload PDF transcripts, degree certificates and your English score report; applications without these are not reviewed.
documents: PDF transcripts from all post-secondary institutions (with reverse side)
One academic and one professional reference
admissions.selection_process: Rolling review of complete applications against programme prerequisites and campus preferences.
important_dates: Fall 2027 deadline (international, out of country): 15 June 2027
admissions.about_provider: Northeastern University is a private R1 research university based in Boston, Massachusetts, known for its co-operative education model. It runs a global network of campuses in the US and Canada.
admissions.notes: Final official transcripts are due within 30 days of the term start.

admissions.title: Northeastern University MS programmes in Engineering (Fall 2027)
admissions.deadline_note: Final deadline for international MS applicants applying from outside the US; the table gives 'June 15' without a year, and the page states the fee waiver applies to Spring 2027 and Fall 2027 terms. Applicants already in the US have until 1 July.

admissions.description:
Northeastern's Graduate School of Engineering admits international students to its MS programmes for Fall 2027, with a final deadline of 15 June for applicants living outside the United States (1 July for international applicants inside the US). Programmes span the college's engineering departments, including a Robotics MS with computer science, electrical and computer, mechanical and chemical engineering concentrations.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis as soon as files are complete, using a holistic review. GRE scores are optional, and the application fee is waived for new MS applicants for the Spring and Fall 2027 terms. An 'Alternative Application' option lets applicants name one or two additional programmes in case the first choice does not admit them.

African applicants should apply well before June to leave time for the I-20 and visa process, and must upload complete scanned transcripts with the grading scale.

Other Graduate School of Engineering MS programmes

important_dates: Fall 2027 final deadline (outside the US): 15 June
Fall 2027 final deadline (inside the US): 1 July

admissions.duration: Varies by programme (for example 18, 24 or 36 months)
admissions.tuition: Listed per programme in RMB (2026-entry examples: RMB 150,000 to 200,000 for most MSc/MA/MRes programmes, RMB 320,000 for the International MBA; 2027 figures to be updated)

Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University in Suzhou is taking applications for about 60 taught master's and MRes programmes beginning in September 2027, in areas such as applied mathematics, artificial intelligence, data science, engineering, management, TESOL and an international MBA. The portal for the 2027 intake is open, and the September deadline is 15 June 2027.

Applications are only processed once the personal statement, transcripts and English test result are in. Referees are contacted directly, and the university may ask for an interview or extra documents. Places are allocated in the order in which deposits and fees are paid, so applying early matters.

XJTLU is a joint venture between Xi'an Jiaotong University and the University of Liverpool, which gives African graduates an English-taught master's in China linked to a UK university. Partial merit scholarships and a Belt and Road Friendship scholarship can reduce tuition.

admissions.notes: Contacts: pgadmissions@xjtlu.edu.cn and international@xjtlu.edu.cn. English-test exemptions exist for nationals of listed majority English-speaking countries.

admissions.title: International undergraduate programmes (English- and Chinese-taught), Fall 2027
admissions.deadline_note: Closing date 15 June 2027; the page warns that some programme deadlines may change, so check the online portal.

admissions.description:
Zhejiang University of Technology (ZJUT) in Hangzhou admits international students to bachelor's degrees starting in fall 2027, including 13 English-taught majors in fields such as chemical, mechanical, electrical, civil and environmental engineering, computer science, software engineering, finance and business administration.

Admission considers academic results, CSCA scores and language level, with a written test or interview where needed. Offers are made in batches, and the first year's tuition must be prepaid to secure a place.

Fees are modest by international standards and ZJUT offers freshman and Chinese Government scholarships, so it is a practical choice for African students looking for English-taught engineering in China. English-taught programmes run only if enough students enrol.

Valid CSCA score report (subjects depend on programme)

High school diploma or pre-graduation certificate
admissions.selection_process: Applicants are ranked on academic results, CSCA scores and language level, with a written test or interview where required; pre-admission notices are issued in batches.
admissions.about_provider: Zhejiang University of Technology is a public university in Hangzhou with strengths in engineering and applied sciences. Its International College handles international student admission.

admissions.deadline_note: Application window 1 February to 30 June 2027 per ZJNU's 2027 undergraduate admission guide; scholarship deadlines differ.

admissions.description:
Zhejiang Normal University (ZJNU) admits international undergraduates for 2027 to around 30 programmes taught in Chinese and 7 taught in English. Applications open on 1 February and close on 30 June 2027.

Applicants are reviewed first for eligibility, then by the college on language level, school record, learning ability and fit for the major. Admission is competitive.

Tuition is comparatively low, and ZJNU lists several scholarships (Chinese Government, Zhejiang provincial and university awards), making it an affordable option for African students interested in studying in China.
degree_names: About 30 Chinese-taught and 7 English-taught bachelor's programmes (see ZJNU programme catalogue)

High school graduate
CSCA results
HSK certificate for Chinese-taught programmes
IELTS, TOEFL or Duolingo for English-taught programmes if English is not your first language
admissions.financial_aid: Chinese Government Scholarship Type A (via embassies, roughly November to early February) and Type B (usually May), International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship, and Zhejiang Provincial and ZJNU international student scholarships.

No-drug statement and mental health survey

Study plan of at least 800 words

admissions.deadline_note: Applications run from 1 February to 30 June 2027; scholarship deadlines differ.

admissions.financial_aid: Chinese Government Scholarship Type A (via embassies) and Type B (agency number 10345), International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship, MOFCOM Scholarship (Comparative Education), and Zhejiang Provincial Government / ZJNU scholarships.

admissions.title: Wheelock College of Education & Human Development Graduate Programmes (Fall 2027)
admissions.deadline_note: International on-campus applicants: final deadline 1 July 2027 for most master's and certificate programmes. Priority deadline for all programmes is 15 January 2027; some programmes close earlier (see important dates).
admissions.description:
Boston University's Wheelock College of Education & Human Development admits students to master's (EdM, MS, MAT), certificate and doctoral programmes in education, counselling, human development and related fields. This entry covers the Fall 2027 master's round.

All applicants are encouraged to meet the 15 January 2027 priority deadline.
